observations.content: Assistant confirmed web tool lineage: ~/.pi/agent/settings.json packages: ["npm:pi-mcp-adapter@2.11.0", "npm:pi-mcp-adapter", "npm:pi-web-access"]; web_fetch is a self-dev extension (ext tự dev) copied from amosblomqvist pi-config; web_search/fetch_content/source_check/get_search_content come from the pi-web-access npm marketplace package loaded globally; pi has no builtin web tools.
Assistant corrected its own earlier statement: the web tools come from the pi-web-access package, not a harness fetch_content.

pi-web-access being global explains why OM worker sessions and subagents get web_search (learn-researcher.md's web_search is satisfied by the package, not a local ext) and why the workspace did not need to port the author's web-search extension.

Assistant answered the 3-event question: use all three events, each plugs a different gap — turn_end (inject right after current round while main runs multi-round), before_agent_start (inject before loop starts when main idle and user just submitted prompt), agent_settled (final drain after retry/compaction/follow-up chain).
Anti-duplicate approach: all three events call a single drainQueue() whose first step is an atomic splice (whoever runs first cuts the queue clean) so the other two paths see empty.
Assistant decided turn_start event adds nothing since turn_end + before_agent_start + agent_settled covers everything.
before_agent_start can inject via return {message}; turn_end and agent_settled inject via pi.sendMessage; both paths are atomic-dedup'd.

User said 'Nhất trí' (agreed) to the overall plan; assistant planned phased implementation: Phase 1 (file-queue both directions, 3-event drain, main-to-child single status check then queue-or-direct-prompt with no loop, bounded backstop with anti-double-send marker, interrupt:true flag, researcher merge, visual-tools header cleanup) and Phase 2 (ask_question park/wait/absorb, name-registry and resume-by-name).

Assistant read the full current paseo-channel.ts (230 lines) design: MAIN→CHILD daemon interrupt-and-replace path; CHILD→MAIN never-interrupt path with in-extension queue flushed as follow-up when main goes idle via status polling.

paseo-channel.ts current implementation: findMcpEndpoint locates paseo-pi-mcp dirs with callerAgentId exact-match checking; mcpCall does raw JSON-RPC tools/call over loopback endpoint; createAgent wraps create_agent with notifyOnFinish and thinkingOptionId.

Current sendToSubagent always daemon-sends send_agent_prompt background:true; current sendToMain status-checks once then either queues in pendingToMain and polls flushWhenIdle every 5s (or 15s on error) until main idles, or sends directly when idle.

Assistant designed new file-queue: JSONL path ~/.pi/agent/subagent-channel/<targetAgentId>.jsonl with per-line {id, from, fromRole, kind, text, ts}; push = appendFileSync; drain = rename file to .draining-<ts> then read+delete for race safety (appendFileSync opens per call so concurrently-appended messages are never lost).
New sendToMain design: no daemon call unless idle; busy/unknown status once → push to main queue file drained at main's next event; idle → direct send_agent_prompt (steer-back semantics).

New sendToSubagent design: symmetric with sendToMain — status once, busy → child queue file drained at its turn_end, idle → send_agent_prompt; plus interrupt:true flag for urgent cases always daemon-sends.

Assistant flagged E2E problem: children spawned after file sync run new code but the assistant's own main session keeps old code and would not drain the file queue, so child-to-main messages via file would be stuck; E2E needs a fresh main session, unit test + smoke-rpc done now.

index.ts structure read: applyRole allowlist/tool_call defense around line 330-375; message_subagent registered ~line 540 with sendToSubagent; message_main registered ~line 568 wrapping message in <subagent-message from role> tags and resolving mainId from labels subagent.parent or paseo.parent-agent-id; resolveSelf parses agent records matching sessionId for role resolution.
resolveSelf role priority: explicit subagent.role label first, else daemon-stamped paseo.parent-agent-id (machine-spawned -> floor/default-deny), else human-created agent is main with full tools.

Assistant planned index.ts changes: add 3-event drain wiring (flushInbound with in-flight guard, before_agent_start returns customType subagent-message message, turn_end/agent_settled use pi.sendMessage), change message_main result text, add interrupt param to message_subagent default false.

Grep results: no tests/ directory exists in extensions/subagent-types (so no existing unit tests reference old exports); subagent-types supports system-prompt and auto-exit via agent def.systemPrompt used as initialPrompt; visual-tools/index.ts not at expected path (had to check actual location later).

Planned researcher merge: merged agents/researcher.md = name researcher + tools web_search/web_fetch/safe_bash + system-prompt append + auto-exit true + keep current rich body; delete learn-researcher.md.

Planned visual-tools header fix: rewrite header comment to describe reality (plain extension + CUSTOM_TOOL_EXTENSIONS), remove dead registerToolExtensions call and globalThis block, after first reading visual-tools/index.ts structure.
